description: A document-signing envelope native to the religious-corp substrate (per ADR-2605231230). The PDF/document body lives on IPFS (referenced by `documentCid`); only metadata + signer roster lives on MST. Signers authenticate with DID + WebAuthn passkey assertions (no email/OAuth/SMS OTP). Completion produces an `com.etzhayyim.esign.completedEvent`, which is later anchored to Base L2 by anchor-cron yielding an `com.etzhayyim.esign.anchoredEvent`. Document signing for religious-corp documents MUST use this lexicon — DocuSign/Adobe/RazorpaySign passthroughs (`com.etzhayyim.apps.lawfirm.eSign*`) are reserved for fiat receipts and external counsel intake per ADR-2605192115 §4.

requesterDid.description: DID of the principal that issued the envelope. Must hold the WebAuthn key controlling the requester role.

subject.description: Human-readable subject line for the envelope (no PII; metadata only).

documentCid.description: IPFS CIDv1 (raw codec, sha2-256, base32 lower) of the canonical document body (typically a PDF). Pinned by ipfs-pinner.

documentSha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the canonical document bytes. Required as a defense-in-depth hash independent of IPFS multihash. Prefix `0x`, lowercase.

documentMimeType.description: MIME type of the canonical document body. Default `application/pdf`.

signers.description: Ordered list of signer DIDs. Order matters when `signingOrder` is `sequential`.

signingOrder.description: How signers must complete. `sequential` enforces the array order; `parallel` accepts any order.

requiredMembershipTier.description: Optional gating: if set, all signers must hold the named membership tier (per ADR-2605172700). Empty/omitted means no tier check.

purpose.description: Charter-aligned purpose tag. Constrains which template families may be used (per ADR-2605192115 §3 + Charter Rider v2.0 §2(b)(c)). The four commodity-flow values (`donation-in-kind`, `internal-allocation`, `surplus-routing`, `operational-supply`) are added per ADR-2605231500 for AAT-bound agent-driven UNSPSC flows.

subjectClassifications.description: Optional list of classification-system subjects the envelope concerns. Used by agent-driven UNSPSC flows (per ADR-2605231500) to bind envelopes to commodity / occupation / process catalog actors. UNSPSC actors at `did:web:c{code}.etzhayyim.com` receive notification fan-out on completion.

commodityManifestUri.description: Optional AT URI of an `com.etzhayyim.esign.commodityManifest` record carrying a multi-commodity batch manifest. When present, the envelope covers all commodities listed in the manifest (1 envelope = N commodity codes, batching pattern per ADR-2605231500).

requesterAgentAuthorityRef.description: Optional AT URI of an `com.etzhayyim.agent.authority` record proving AAT-bound delegated authority. Required when `requesterDid` is an AI agent (not a human Adherent SBT holder); absent when the requester is a human signing in their personal capacity. Per ADR-2605231500.

charterAttestationRef.description: Optional snapshot of the ChartersComplianceRegistry attestation captured at envelope creation. Allows downstream verifiers to detect attestation drift between mint time and signing time.

sanctionsScreenRef.description: Optional snapshot of the sanctions screening result captured at envelope creation. References the sanctions actor's per-counterparty screening record.

councilEscalationRequired.description: Derived flag — when true, requester-only signing is insufficient and the envelope requires Council Lv6+ ≥3 multisig. Set by the orchestrator based on the matching UNSPSC processManifest's councilEscalationThreshold.

customsRef.description: Optional AT URI of a customs declaration record. Required when the matching UNSPSC processManifest has customsRequired=true.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 deadline after which the envelope auto-transitions to `expired`.

status.description: Current envelope state. State machine: draft → requested → partially_signed → completed → anchored (terminal). Branches: declined / expired (terminal).

councilMirror.description: When true, the `anchoredEvent` MUST also mirror to the geth-private constitutional chain (per ADR-2605192245 4-layer pattern). Required for council-resolution / land-donation / force-rd-consent / public-fund-disbursement.

scheme.description: Classification system. `unspsc` = UNSPSC commodity code (per 2026-05-23 commit 9cd4fe73d); `isco` = ISCO-08 occupation code (per `20-actors/isco/`); `apqc` = APQC PCF process ID (per `00-contracts/lexicons/com/etzhayyim/apqc/`); `bunken` = bibliographic identifier (per `20-actors/bunken/`); other = free-form, document in adjacent record.

code.description: Identifier within the scheme (e.g., `43221501` for UNSPSC, `2611` for ISCO, `3.2.1.1` for APQC).

did.description: Optional DID of the classification actor (e.g., `did:web:c43221501.etzhayyim.com` for UNSPSC). When present, notification fan-out posts to this DID.

schemeId.description: Optional sub-scheme identifier for multi-scheme classifications like Bunken (`ndl:bib`, `lccn`, `viaf`, `doi`, `ark`, etc., per `20-actors/bunken/CLAUDE.md`).
